quests.title: A Parcel for Bigg Market Deli
quests.giver: a resident of BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art
quests.summary: Carry a brown-paper parcel to a relative in Bigg Market Deli, then bring word back to BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art.

steps.text: Take the parcel to Bigg Market Deli.
steps.line: Oh, from BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art? That'll be my sister's doing. A cardigan, again. Tell her I'm wearing the last one.

steps.text: Take the word back to BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art.
steps.line: Oh, you've been! And she's wearing it? Well. That's me told, and a tea owed to you.

start.ask: Alright pet, would you do me a kindness? There's a parcel here for my sister in Bigg Market Deli. It's only a cardigan and a lot of string.
start.accept: Marvellous. Mind the string, it's load-bearing.
